tagline: China's leading AI-powered search and cloud platform with autonomous driving ambitions
hero_kpi_rationale: Baidu is strategically pivoting toward AI and cloud as core growth drivers, with its Apollo autonomous driving and Ernie AI model fueling long-term value beyond traditional search.

kpis.name: R&D Investments as Percentage of Revenue
kpis.explanation: Share of research and development expenses in revenue.
kpis.description: Baidu maintains a high R&D rate to support its development in artificial intelligence and cloud computing.
kpis.signal: High investment rate in AI and cloud, typical of tech leaders.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: Baidu has reduced headcount to improve operational efficiency, particularly in its traditional businesses.
kpis.signal: Headcount reduction aligned with sectoral rationalization 2023-2025.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Gross margin is slightly improving due to better efficiency and higher-value services.
kpis.signal: Stable margin despite transition to more costly activities (AI, cloud).

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin declined slightly due to rising expenses in AI and cloud not yet fully monetized.
kpis.signal: Margin pressure linked to massive investments in AI.

kpis.name: Share of Cloud Contracts Including AI Features
kpis.explanation: Percentage of cloud contracts that include artificial intelligence capabilities.
kpis.description: More customers are adopting Baidu's cloud solutions integrating generative AI via Ernie Bot.
kpis.signal: Rapid growth in AI integration within cloud solutions.

kpis.name: Volume of AI API Calls
kpis.explanation: Number of monthly calls to artificial intelligence application programming interfaces.
kpis.description: The volume of calls to Ernie Bot APIs tripled in one year, driven by developers and enterprises.
kpis.signal: Explosion in AI API usage, indicating massive adoption.

ai_positioning.summary: Baidu is a leader in AI in China, with its Ernie Bot model competing directly with major Western models. The company is integrating AI into its search engines, cloud, and autonomous vehicles.
evidence: Launch of Ernie Bot 4.5 in 2025 with performance close to GPT-4
Over 1 billion monthly AI API calls in 2025
Partnerships with automotive manufacturers for Apollo autonomous driving
